_meta.note: Venture cards fire on the developer's drawn milestones inside their windows; reading_sign as events_v.json (venture moves 0, doc 43 §0.10).

event_cards.title: Design Sent to the Factory
event_cards.body: Halyard Silicon has sent its first chip design to the foundry. If the first wafers work, it will have silicon in about a quarter; most first designs need at least one fix.

choices.label: Reserve chips from the first run

event_cards.basis: Doc 49 Q1: tape-out to first silicon ~1 quarter [B]; 14% first-silicon success [A/B]

event_cards.trigger: first silicon (drawn): working, or a respin
event_cards.title: First Silicon

working.title: First Silicon Works
working.body: Halyard's first chips boot and run real models. Qualification with customers starts now; volume is still a year or so away.

respin.title: Back to the Factory
respin.body: Halyard's first chips have a flaw that software can't route around. A corrected design goes back to the factory: one or two quarters lost, and a cash call for the new masks.

event_cards.basis: Doc 49 Q1: a respin costs 1-2 quarters and a mask set ($20-40M at 3 nm) plus burn [C]

volume.title: Halyard Ships in Volume
volume.body: Halyard Silicon's chip is in volume production. Backers with a reservation get the first deliveries at their discount; everyone else waits for whatever the foundry can make.

volume_capped.title: Volume, Rationed
volume_capped.body: Halyard is in production, but the foundry gave it half the wafers it asked for. Reservation holders are served first; the rest of the year's orders wait.

cancelled.title: Halyard Shuts Down
cancelled.body: Halyard Silicon ran out of runway before its chip reached volume. The team is being hired away and the designs go to auction; stakes and deposits are lost.

event_cards.basis: Doc 49 Q2 (outcome shares) and Q4 (allocation: the top four buyers took >90% of advanced packaging in 2025 [C])

event_cards.title: A Buyer for Halyard
event_cards.body: One of the largest cloud companies offers to buy Halyard Silicon outright, mostly for its team and designs. Your stake would be paid out now at well above its last mark.
event_cards.basis: Doc 49 Q2: pre-volume buyouts at 10-17x money raised (Nervana 2016, Habana 2019) [B]; licence-and-hire deals (Groq 2025, Enfabrica 2025) [B]
event_cards.note: Blocking needs a stake of 30% or more (mine); otherwise the other holders carry the vote and the stake is sold.
